_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment; ADR-048 semantic reference for the order
_meta.description: A down payment on an order is an ARInvoice of type code 386 with a downPayment group; the final invoice of the order carries downPayment.kind final, one negative invoice line per down payment and VAT rate (invoiceLines[].downPaymentInvoiceId) and the deductions it took. The posting of both lives in MaterialiseGlTransactionAction (advances account, default 2310); the check and the stamp on issue live in DownPaymentGuard, declared on ARInvoice.issue in add-shillinq-bookkeeping-compliance.json so the check runs before the posting.

downPayment.title: Down payment
downPayment.description: Set on a down-payment invoice of an order and on the final invoice that deducts the order's down payments.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Down payment for an invoice raised up front on an order, final for the invoice that deducts them.

orderReference.title: Order
orderReference.description: The order, by semantic type (ADR-048): a shillinq OrderPrimitive or an order or quote in another app.

orderLabel.title: Order label
orderLabel.description: How the order is named on the invoice, for example its order number.

orderNetTotal.title: Order net total
orderNetTotal.description: The order's net total the down payment was computed from.

orderVatBreakdown.title: Order VAT breakdown
orderVatBreakdown.description: The order's net total per VAT rate the down payment was computed from.

rate.title: VAT rate
rate.description: VAT rate as a fraction, 0.21 for 21 percent.

net.title: Net
net.description: Net amount of the order at this rate.

percentage.title: Percentage
percentage.description: The percentage of the order's net total asked up front.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The fixed net amount asked up front.

deductedOnInvoiceId.title: Deducted on invoice
deductedOnInvoiceId.description: On a down payment: the final invoice that deducted it, stamped when that invoice is issued.

deductedOnInvoiceNumber.title: Deducted on invoice number
deductedOnInvoiceNumber.description: The number of the final invoice that deducted this down payment.

deductions.title: Deductions
deductions.description: On a final invoice: every down payment it deducts, per VAT rate.

net.title: Net
net.description: Net amount deducted at this rate.

invoiceLines.title: Invoice lines
invoiceLines.description: A list of invoice lines entries.

downPaymentInvoiceId.title: Deducted down payment
downPaymentInvoiceId.description: On a deduction line of a final invoice: the down-payment invoice this line takes off. Its net amount is booked to the advances account, not to revenue.
